target_customer: Private equity, venture capital, family office and fund-of-funds teams
problem: Diligence, monitoring and reporting for private market investors is slow manual work across Excel, Word and PowerPoint.
business_model: B2B SaaS for private market investors
product_category: AI agents for private market diligence

founders.name: Anton Otaner
founders.background_notes: YC page lists blockchain infrastructure at Mint and AR product at EPHAS. Education not found in an opened source.

founders.background_notes: YC page names Tommy without surname; surname and CTO role come from a search snippet.

technical_complexity.rationale: Document and spreadsheet agents on LLM APIs with integration into Office tools, standard engineering with hard accuracy requirements.

defensibility.rationale: Later pivot to a firm-specific data model suggests the early tool alone was easy to copy; stored private firm data could create lock-in.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Well funded finance AI platforms covered diligence and document analysis; dated launch evidence near the batch was not found.

market_need_then: Private equity diligence is document heavy and LLMs made automation feasible in 2023, but no sourced demand figures were found.

branding.domain_note: Uses clarum.ai and clarum.dev; exact .com not established.

identity.visual_style: Minimal dark wordmark, little detail available
identity.voice_and_tone: Direct and confident, short declarative sentences

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community evidence about the brand; other organizations use the Clarum name.

pivots.from: AI associate for private equity diligence in Excel, Word and PowerPoint
pivots.to: Intelligence layer for private capital structuring firm data into a queryable model
pivots.why: Not stated; inferred only from current site versus YC page, date approximate

outcome_analysis: Clarum is active with a team of two, started as an AI diligence assistant for private market investors and now describes itself as an intelligence layer for private capital. Little verifiable funding or traction is public, so the story is unclear beyond early stage survival.
